back_content.text: 结论：完成跟读，注意限定词重读（only/some区分绝对化干扰项的关键词）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Only some of the participants reported significant improvement, while the majority experienced moderate benefits, and a small number showed no measurable change at all.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：only some（部分）/ the majority（多数但非全部）/ a small number（少数）/ no measurable change（无变化）= 四种结果分布，无绝对化。② 核心规律：跟读时重读量化限定词（only/some/majority/small/no），这些词是排除绝对化干扰项的关键信号。③ 验证与迁移：跟读后能准确复述数量分布（部分/多数/少数），是本卡成功标准。
tips: only some / a few / most = 表示程度的量化词，考题中是排除"all"类干扰项的关键。
跟读时重读这些量化词，养成在听力中捕捉数量信息的习惯。

back_content.text: 结论：正确选项B：部分员工接受了培训；A=绝对化，C=偷换对象，D=无中生有。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The company provided cybersecurity training to selected employees in the IT and finance departments, focusing on phishing detection and password management.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：selected employees（不是所有人）/ IT and finance（两个部门非全公司）/ phishing + password（两个具体主题）。② 干扰项分析：A（"all employees" = 绝对化）；C（"HR department" = 偷换对象/部门）；D（"external consultants" = 无中生有）。③ 验证与迁移：本题综合考察三类干扰项识别；答题策略：先排除绝对化（all）→排除偷换（HR）→排除无中生有（consultants）→确认B。
tips: 三步排除法：绝对化→偷换对象→无中生有，剩下的就是正确答案。
selected / certain / some = 限定范围词，对应排除"all / every"类选项。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再识别该中心在国际上最受关注的研究领域。

back_content.text: 结论：最受国际关注的领域：computational neuroscience（不是 materials science 也不是 molecular biology）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The research center has made significant strides in three distinct areas: materials science, molecular biology, and computational neuroscience. Of these, the work in computational neuroscience has attracted the most international attention.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："Of these" = 从已列举的三项中作比较排除；"most...attention" = 最高级比较，是排他性的。② 核心规律：CET6 干扰项：题目含多个并列项，但只有最高级/特定限定词指向的那个是答案，其余是干扰。③ 验证与迁移：干扰项：materials science / molecular biology（均被提及但不是 "most international attention"）；答案：computational neuroscience。
tips: most/least + 形容词 = 最高级唯一指向，其他选项是干扰，即使被提及也不符合最高等级限制。
"Of these" = 从中选一，标志排除法开始，即将指出唯一答案。

back_content.text: 结论：安全隐患准确位置：sections B and C 的通风系统（不是 eastern wing）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The inspector's report noted that the facility met safety standards in most respects. However, concerns were raised specifically about the ventilation system in sections B and C, not the eastern wing as previously reported.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："specifically about" = 明确限定；"not the eastern wing as previously reported" = 直接否定干扰项。② 核心规律：CET6 否定排除："not X" + "but Y" = Y 是答案，X 是干扰项，尤其 "not...as previously reported" = 刻意纠正旧信息。③ 验证与迁移：答案：sections B and C（通风系统）；干扰项：eastern wing（被明确否定）。
tips: not X but Y = 明确排除干扰，Y 是实际答案；"not...as previously..." = 纠正型干扰排除。
听力题中出现 "not" + 位置/人名/数字 = 该信息被否定，选同类中未否定的。

back_content.text: 结论：未涉及的议题：tax policy changes（第三项）；仅详细谈了 healthcare reform 和 infrastructure investment。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The candidate's campaign promises centered on three issues: healthcare reform, infrastructure investment, and tax policy changes. During the debate, she spoke at length about the first two, but did not address the third.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："but did not address the third" = 直接说明第三项被跳过；the third = tax policy changes（按顺序推断）。② 核心规律：CET6 顺序干扰：列举三项后说明某项未被提及，需记清顺序（第一/二/三项）。③ 验证与迁移：干扰项：healthcare/infrastructure（均被提及）；答案：the third = tax policy。
tips: first/second/third + "did not address/mention" = 标准顺序排除题，记住序号和对应项目。
spoke at length about = 详细讲了，是 "确实提到" 的标志，与答案相反方向。

back_content.text: 结论：最主要因素：regulatory changes（监管变化）；supply chain 和 staffing 也被提及但不是 by far the most significant。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Several factors contributed to the project delay, including supply chain disruptions, staffing shortages, and unexpected regulatory changes. According to the project manager, the regulatory changes were by far the most significant.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："by far the most significant" = 压倒性的最高级，排他性指向；"according to" = 引用权威判断。② 核心规律：CET6 因果干扰排除：多因素题中，"by far the most" / "primarily" = 唯一最重要答案，其余均是干扰。③ 验证与迁移：答案：regulatory changes；干扰项：supply chain disruptions + staffing shortages（被提及但被排出最高级）。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：While the early clinical trials tested the drug on patients aged 18 to 45, the latest study extended the cohort to include patients aged 46 to 70. The preliminary results for this older group appear promising.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："While... early trials" = 背景信息（干扰项），"latest study extended" = 更新内容（答案所在）。② 核心规律：CET6 新旧信息干扰：while/previously/earlier = 旧信息（干扰），latest/new/extended = 当前，答案在新信息部分。③ 验证与迁移：干扰项：18-45（旧研究范围）；答案：46-70（新增范围）+ promising results（初步结论）。
tips: while/previously + old info → latest/new/current + new info = 新信息是答案，旧信息是干扰。
the preliminary results appear promising = 初步结论，但 preliminary = 尚待确认，用词精确。

tips: focus on X / concentrate on X = 正向指令，X 是重点任务。
not on Y / excluding Z = 排除词，Y/Z 是干扰项；which will be covered later = 明确说明是延迟内容。
